topPick.thesis: Allstate (ALL) is trading at 6.1x P/E, a 61% discount to its sector average of 15.8x; RSI at 69 reflects strong but extended momentum — watch for potential consolidation. Three-month price momentum of +29.1% reflects exceptional institutional accumulation, with EPS growing +338% year-on-year, underpinned by a bullish MACD crossover confirming upward price pressure. Composite score of 78/100 places ALL in the top 1% of S&P 500 constituents across all four analytical strategies, outperforming its sector by +19.4% over the past quarter.
